result.description: HelioFrame Aurora Quill is a fictional 34-inch ultrawide monitor built for writers, storyboard artists, and layout editors who need expansive horizontal workspace rather than storage or compute hardware. It features a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 120Hz refresh rate, factory-calibrated color, and a matte anti-glare finish tuned for long-form editing sessions. Connectivity includes USB-C with display and charging support, DisplayPort, HDMI, and a built-in KVM switch for switching between two desktops. The monitor emphasizes eye comfort with flicker-reduction and low-blue-light modes, making it suitable for studio desks, libraries, and remote creative workstations.
result.title: Aurora Quill 34in Ultrawide Creative Monitor
